text: Sending y replaced that with a confirmation listing name, role, race, gender, and alignment, plus the lines "y + Yes; start game", "n - No; choose role again", and "q - Quit". The listed role and race were not the same on every new process.

Sending space while "--More--" or "-More--" was visible replaced the paragraph with a picture of walls, periods, @, and sometimes d, plus a welcome line. Sending a letter while --More-- was still visible did not change that picture.
Starting again in a home directory that already had a save showed "Restoring save file..." instead of the pick-character question.
Startup batch: y on [ynaq], y on confirm, spaces through --More-- (letters fail there). Extra space waits a turn on the map, which is safe at spawn.
Bumping a wall prints a message that swallows later letters in the same batch; only space clears it.
Kicking a locked door can smash it to . and strain a muscle, lowering Dex.
The starting room can have no visible door; searching while adjacent to a wall can reveal a hidden + door.
A | breaking a horizontal - wall is an open doorway and is walkable.
The starting @ can hide an up-stair < that appears after you step off that tile.
A d in the corridor by the starting room can be a hostile jackal.
A . breaking a horizontal - wall is a walkable doorway.
Opening a closed + can print "The door resists!" when the door stays closed.
A locked + can shatter to . after several WHAMMM kicks with Dex unchanged.
After stepping through a . in a - wall, @ can vanish from the mapped view until you re-enter a mapped room or swap with the pet.
The starting f is a pet named Rex; moving onto its tile swaps places instead of attacking.
